Body.Content:
Quality evaluaton allows quality managers to create bulk record samples with equal distribution across representatives. This helps ensure sampling is balanced and avoids over- or under-representing any individual representative in review sets.

When generating a bulk sample via evaluation plans, the sampling process can distribute selected records evenly by representative. Instead of pulling records only from the overall eligible pool, the system groups eligible records by representative and selects a balanced number from each group.

Benefits:

Creates fairer and more representative review samples

Reduces manual effort needed to balance samples across representatives.

Improves consistency for QA, audit, and performance review workflows.

Helps teams compare representative-level outcomes using more evenly distributed data

User impact:

Users who create or manage bulk samples will have a more balanced sampling output when sampling by representative.

Existing sampling workflows remain available unless otherwise configured.

GA date: September CY2026
